title: Depths of Knowledge Vol 4
description: In this fourth volume of this series, I describe my practical approach to selecting figures before the cutting process begins.

media.alt: Straight on wide angle shot of the textbook sculpture.
media.caption: I began the process by flipping through the pages of the textbook and noting the page number (i.e., depth) of the figures.

media.alt: Wide angle lens shot from the bottom edge of the book tilted at 45 degrees.
media.caption: As I progressed through the pages I was aware of the positioning of each figure so that they would not completely overlap and having variable depth.

media.alt: Wide angle lens shot from the left edge of the book tilted at 45 degrees.
media.caption: Unlike traditional collage, the figures were positioned by depth according to the page number where each image is found in the book.

media.alt: Wide angle lens shot from the right edge of the book tilted at 45 degrees.
Wide angle lens shot from the top edge of the book tilted at 45 degrees.
